summary: Filterable directory composed of the existing profile cards.
whenToUse: Showing a searchable collection of community members.
whenNotToUse: For a single person use ProfileCard; for a compact list use a table.

props.name: query
props.description: Controlled value used to filter members.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown when there are no matches.

keyboard.action: Reaches the search field and then the profile links and actions.

accessibility: The section has an accessible name and the search field uses the visible label.
responsive: The grid adapts to the available width and stays single-column in narrow containers.
customization: The cards are ProfileCard instances; colors and spacing use --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: The component only filters local text: remote search remains the consumer's responsibility.
limits: Non-text fields in jobTitle are not included in the search.
